reader_summary.headline: By 2012, NVIDIA was on a decade-long road to nowhere.
reader_summary.overview: By 2012, NVIDIA was on a decade-long road to nowhere. Or so most rational observers of the company thought. CEO Jensen Huang was plowing all the cash from the company’s gaming business into building a highly speculative platform with few clear use cases and no obviously large market opportunity..
